claims.statement: The workflow supports governed support triage and human handoff.
A clean synthetic trial runs locally without paid APIs or platform writes.
Seven synthetic cases exercise five supported redaction types and one safe identifier.
Unsupported or unresolved policy cases abstain and require human handoff.
Two privacy components were screened without forcing an unnecessary dependency.
A synthetic privacy requirement links implementation to regression evidence.
Exact-pattern, synthetic-data and human-authority limitations remain explicit.
An optional dependency-free local vector classification hint can be compared with the deterministic keyword baseline while privacy, policy resolution and human-handoff gates remain authoritative.
Local-vector classification hints expose a deterministic score margin and recommend human review for low-confidence, narrow-margin or unknown messages without changing the keyword policy gate.
A bounded replay-review export organizes passed, failed and excluded feedback without retaining raw customer messages or applying policy decisions.
A chronological reviewer-history summary exposes status counts without retaining ticket text or applying policy decisions.
Sanitized review history can be organized into a bounded owner-follow-up queue without sending replies, changing policy or retaining ticket text.
Sanitized owner follow-up items expose age, open or closed state and stale visibility without closing tickets, changing policy or sending replies.

boundaries: Selected exact patterns only; this is not full DLP, identity verification or a production privacy claim.
All tickets, policies and reviewer records are synthetic; no real customer adoption is claimed.
A real pilot requires authenticated reviewers, approved retention, ticketing integration, privacy review and monitored false-positive/false-negative handling.
